title: PXAPI delivery record v1
description: One delivery attempt of customer artifacts through one channel (Confluence 39846055 §12 gate 6, §15). The channel is an opaque token chosen by the delivering adapter, not a closed vocabulary. The outcome is always stated by status, never by a missing timestamp: a PENDING attempt carries null for both attempted_at and delivered_at, a DELIVERED attempt has both, and a FAILED attempt has attempted_at, a null delivered_at and a sanitised failure. A recipient is only ever an opaque reference held by the adapter, never an e-mail address or any other contact detail, and an attempt always names at least one artifact it carried.

run_id.description: Required. The Analysis Run this delivery belongs to.

delivery_id.description: Required. The stable identity of this delivery attempt; the internal analysis record references it.

channel.description: Required. The channel the artifacts were delivered through, as an opaque token defined by the delivering adapter (e.g. email, partner_portal). The vocabulary is deliberately not closed in v1.

artifact_refs.description: Required. The customer artifacts this attempt delivered or tried to deliver. At least one is required; an empty array is invalid, because a delivery of nothing is not a delivery attempt.

recipient_ref.description: Optional. An opaque reference to the recipient context held by the delivering adapter. Absent means the channel has no addressable recipient (e.g. a pickup portal the customer opens). Never an e-mail address or any other contact detail.

status.description: Required. The outcome of this attempt. PENDING: the delivery has not been attempted yet. DELIVERED: the channel accepted the artifacts. FAILED: the attempt ended without acceptance and failure states why.

attempted_at.description: Required, nullable. When the delivery was attempted; null if and only if status is PENDING, because nothing has been attempted yet.

delivered_at.description: Required, nullable. When the channel accepted the delivery; non-null if and only if status is DELIVERED, null for PENDING and FAILED.

failure.description: Conditional. Present if and only if status is FAILED: the sanitised reason the attempt failed. Forbidden for PENDING and DELIVERED.
